title: Agent Trace Critical Path
hints: Index children by parent id, then walk down from the root. Anything you never reach is an orphan.
Self time = duration minus the UNION of the children's intervals, each clipped to the parent. Parallel children overlap, so a sum double counts.
Write one union_length(intervals) helper (sort, then merge) and use it for both self time and time per kind.
The critical path picks min(children, key=(-end, -start, id)) at each level until it reaches a leaf.
